items.rationale: The week's biggest AI-advertising story, from the primary source: OpenAI opens a new ad format and a measurement stack inside ChatGPT, which puts a bought-and-sold ad surface in the middle of an assistant.
items.excerpt: OpenAI's own announcement of a new ChatGPT ad format and measurement stack — visual ads that appear alongside image-generation results in the U.S. later this month, with an initial test group of advertisers.

items.rationale: Brand-safety plumbing arrives in a chat surface: DoubleVerify and IAS will independently assess how ChatGPT applies brand-safety standards in a sandbox, and Negative Phrases lets brands exclude placements — the first thing a buyer has to evaluate before spending here.
items.excerpt: DoubleVerify and IAS will independently assess how ChatGPT applies brand-safety standards in a sandbox, and OpenAI adds Negative Phrases placement exclusions for brands.

items.rationale: TikTok's Advertising Week package in one place: Buy Direct agentic commerce, a conversational Shopping Assistant, Smart+-powered Search Ads campaigns and Smart+ Creative Selection — agentic buying and agentic selling shipping on the same platform before the holidays.
items.excerpt: TikTok's Advertising Week announcement: agentic commerce with Buy Direct and a conversational Shopping Assistant, Smart+-powered Search Ads campaigns and Smart+ Creative Selection.

items.rationale: AI scene detection manufactures ad inventory that did not exist before: Omnicom Media and Rembrand push in-content insertion further by finding the moments in a video that can be monetised contextually.
items.excerpt: The holdco and the ad-tech platform push in-content ad insertion further, using AI to identify scenes that can be monetized contextually.

items.rationale: AI lands on the point of conversion at scale: Gap Inc. puts conversational shopping agents and the Alta Daily and Daydream recommendation platforms in front of shoppers across Gap, Banana Republic and Old Navy.
items.excerpt: Gap Inc. puts conversational shopping agents and the Alta Daily and Daydream recommendation platforms in front of customers across Gap, Banana Republic and Old Navy.
